to fling (properly, with a quick toss, thus differing from G906, which denotes a deliberate hurl; and from τείνω (see in G1614), which indicates an extended projection); by qualification, to deposit (as if a load); by extension, to disperse
definitions.derivation_source_authored: a primary verb (perhaps rather akin to the base of G4474, through the idea of sudden motion);

definitions.concise_source_authored: Roboam (i.e. Rechobam), an Israelite
Rode, a servant girl
Rhodus, an island of the Mediterranean
whizzingly, i.e. with a crash
definitions.derivation_source_authored: adverb from a derivative of ῥοῖζος (a whir);
